purpose: Runtime-neutral contract for resolving Dallas Gamecast play events into the approved realistic 3D chibi asset library without changing NFL, MLB, or NHL rendering code in this batch.

authoritativeInputs.rule: Never request an action absent from that player's roster.json action inventory.

assetContract.appearance: locked official-current-headshot reference; never infer skin tone or visible appearance from name
assetContract.uniform: current Dallas geometry and roster number locked across base, actions, and signatures

resolutionOrder: verified player signature when event trigger exactly matches signature metadata
position-safe fallback action from this manifest that also exists in roster.json inventory
no asset; retain existing Gamecast non-chibi fallback

runtimeRules.identityKey: team + normalized player name; roster slug is canonical once matched
runtimeRules.teamGuard: Only resolve this manifest for DAL players; never cross-resolve same-name players from another team.
runtimeRules.possessionContinuity: Keep ball attached to the established possession hand through catch/run/return transitions until the play state releases possession.
runtimeRules.anchorContinuity: Blend action transitions around the same bottom-center world anchor; signature root motion must resolve to that anchor.
runtimeRules.staleStateGuard: A new play id resets transient action/signature state before resolving the next event.
runtimeRules.missingAssetBehavior: Fail soft through resolutionOrder; never hide the existing Gamecast scene because a chibi file is missing.
runtimeRules.signatureGuard: Do not synthesize, rename, or infer signatures. Only verifiedSignatureRouting may invoke named signatures.

checks: Every event-map candidate is filtered against roster.json before asset lookup.
All 53 Dallas roster players can fall back to base without requiring a star-only path.
CeeDee Lamb first_down prefers nose-wipe and gracefully falls back when signature frames are absent.
Von Miller sack/TFL/impact events prefer DeSoto Shuffle and gracefully fall back when signature frames are absent.
Unknown events and unknown players do not break or blank Gamecast.
No MLB or NHL path, selector, state, asset, or renderer is referenced by this manifest.
Transparent alpha, camera, lighting, scale, foot anchor, uniform number, and locked appearance remain invariant across transitions.
